{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the conversion rate by customer segment within each channel
# This will help us see if the difference in conversion rates is due to segment composition
conversion_by_segment_channel = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Print the results
print("Conversion rates by channel and customer_segment:")
print(conversion_by_segment_channel)"}
